title: Quick Fix Shattering Slovakian Macaroni Casserole
description: A quick and satisfying Slovakian-inspired casserole featuring macaroni, wine, and a shattering crunchy topping.
instructions: Cook the elbow macaroni according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the dry white wine and beef broth, whisking continuously.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the liquid has reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese and grated parmesan cheese until melted.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked macaroni, pork and cheese mixture, and chopped parsley.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch Dutch oven.
Dot the top of the casserole with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Sprinkle the bread crumbs evenly over the top of the casserole.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
